title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.where: Images 2, 6–7, 10, 14–15; steps range, hyper-care, hyper-shift; kit.jsx Frame
findings.title: Player captions are not equivalent image descriptions
findings.problem: Frame replaces the SVG’s complete description with the step caption. Because the SVG has role="img", its internal text cannot be relied on to supply omitted information. The range step therefore omits the displayed client value, 6.2. More importantly, the hyperkalemia causes shown in hyper-care and hyper-shift—kidney failure, potassium-sparing diuretics, ACE inhibitors, crush injury and burns—are absent from every player caption and narration. A screen-reader user opening the player directly never receives that list.
findings.fix: Provide potassium-specific step descriptions containing the essential information actually displayed, following the STEP_DESC approach already used for isolation. Include the supplied potassium value or invalid-result warning whenever the gauge is visible, and the causes and treatment text whenever their panel is visible. Keep these descriptions separate from the shorter teaching captions.

assessment: Fix the player’s screen-reader descriptions: they omit clinical information shown in the corresponding steps.
